title: Equivariant Jiang–Su Stability for Amenable Actions in the Unital Stably Finite Case
summary: Every action of a countable discrete amenable group on a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite complex C ∗ -algebra that is already Jiang–Su stable absorbs the trivial action on the Jiang–Su algebra up to cocycle conjugacy. No restriction is imposed on the action on the tracial-state simplex. This proves the unital, stably finite case of Szabó's Conjecture A on automatic equivariant Jiang–Su stability.
family_title: Cuntz comparison, nuclear dimension, and equivariant Jiang–Su stability

review.reason: Proves a case of Szabó's conjecture on equivariant Jiang-Su stability for amenable actions.
